notes.title: Anomaly Hunter (Play demo) - Steam Next Fest Live Stream
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Enjoy Steam Next Fest demo festival with us - join our live steam and play [b]Anomaly Hunter[/b] demo!

[b]Anomaly Hunter[/b] - sci-fi hidden object game with unique puzzle and time-traveling mechanics. In the age of time-travelling machines, that's obvious that somebody will mess up - play as detective, who must fix time anomalies and find the guest of honor.

Meet King Arthur, alien mutants and communist dictator - all in a single game. Control time, discover worlds, destroy civilizations just by... CLICKING! Hidden object power!

notes.title: Live Developer Q&A
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

[url=https://discord.gg/T5QM6tX]Hook[/url] team presents our first game - [b]Anomaly Hunter[/b].
It's hidden object puzzler about time-traveling detective. His daily job - fix time anomalies, which started after invention of time-machine. This time he meets new enemy...

Join us at the Summer Game Festival, we'll be answering the questions from the community live.
AMA will be both here and on our [url=https://discord.gg/T5QM6tX][b][u]Discord[/u][/b][/url] server.

See you on Tuesday, June 16th!

[i]Best regards,
Hook team[/i]
